questions.stem: Choose the correct option: Between you and ____, the plan is flawed.
questions.explanation: 'Between' is a preposition, so it takes the object pronoun 'me'. 'Between you and I' is a hypercorrection.

questions.stem: Which sentence is free of a dangling modifier?
options: Walking to school, the rain soaked my bag.
Walking to school, I got my bag soaked in the rain.
Having finished dinner, the dishes were washed.
To pass the exam, hard work is needed.
questions.answer: Walking to school, I got my bag soaked in the rain.
questions.explanation: Only the second sentence has the right doer ('I') right after the opening phrase.

options: She likes reading, to swim, and hiking.
She likes reading, swimming, and to hike.
She likes reading, swimming, and hiking.
She likes to read, swimming, and hikes.
questions.answer: She likes reading, swimming, and hiking.
questions.explanation: All three items take the same -ing form.
